conclusion.summary: Both aspect-ratio arms preserve readable wording, but neither preserves Exact Copy typography. T01 is present at mild severity in every bounded title-bar and species-list observation.

method.scope: Compare only the normalized title-bar and species-list crop pairs against their matching Reference Screen crops.
method.t01_interpretation: Visible glyph regeneration or re-kerning counts as T01 even when wording remains readable and correctly spelled.

species-list.note: Visible rerasterization and re-kerning, especially in Solomon's seal and black-eyed Susan.
